steps.message:
Fixed. `dedupe.py` crashed because `contacts.csv` starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark and uses a lowercase `email` header, so `row["Email"]` raised `KeyError`.

Changes in `/app/dedupe.py`:
- Open the input with `encoding="utf-8-sig"` so the BOM is stripped from the first header.
- Look up `row["email"]` instead of `row["Email"]`.

The existing `.strip().lower()` key handles the case and whitespace variants. The script now writes 41 unique rows (9 duplicates removed) to `/app/contacts_clean.csv`.
